translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Zence grinds her fingers into Reset's temples.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Back then, it was always Zence-chan who

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "So, this time, let's let El-chan have it, okay?"
